title: notes to self - quick inbox & errands
content:
Quick dump / brain-dump for today (notes to self) - 2026-03-04

Top priorities:
- [ ] Finish review of PR #1023 (runtime kernel selection tweaks) — focus on fallback logic + unit tests. Ask Riley about the non-deterministic test failure.
- [ ] Push small patch to autoscaler config to prevent double-scale on error (JIRA-PLAT-452).
- [ ] Write short blurb for Tuesday stand: rollout status + perf numbers for latest quantized model tests.

Meetings / people to ping:
- 10:30 sync w/ Maya — confirm canary rollout windows and SLA test plan. Prep: bring latency p95 numbers and list of traffic routes.
- 13:00 Ops retro (quick notes: incident on 03-02 caused duplicate routing; need an RCA checklist).
- Ping Samir about storage costs estimate for KV cache retention policy.

Follow-ups / TODOs:
- [ ] Add regression prompts to eval set (small subset) for prompt-length 2k -> 4k cases.
- [ ] Add a note in Confluence about fallback compatibility matrix (models + quantization variants).
- [ ] Draft customer-facing note about Dedicated maintenance window (short, must mention minimal impact).

Random dev notes:
- Local repro for intermittent OOM: try smaller batch + force-local-kv to see whether KV cache reuse triggers it.
- Use smaller cached-prefix in integration test to simulate long prefix sequences.
- Consider adding metric for "fallbacks triggered" per-route in console traces.

Personal / errand stuff (so I don't forget):
- [ ] Pick up dry cleaning (Thu)
- [ ] Dentist appt 2026-03-10 09:00 — reschedule if rollout testing needs me
- Call bank about card (fraud alert) — 800-555-0132
- Grocery: milk, eggs, coffee, spinach

Notes to self / questions:
- Is the canary policy currently set to 5% traffic / 15 minutes? Confirm with config in repo.
- If fallback model is quantized and has different tokenization edge cases, we should document expected differences to SRE/customer success.

Scratch ideas (messy):
- Small feature: per-route "graceful fallback" UI in Console where customer can preview fallback model diffs (latency / cost / sample mismatch).
- Add a quick script that flags PRs touching kernel selection + autoscaler so we know high-risk changes at release time.

Misc quick links:
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1023
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-452
- Slack thread: #platform-runtime "oom-on-big-batch" (search)

End of dump. Keep this lightweight — move action items into proper tickets after lunch.
